name: forge-mine
_note: OMEGA FORGE Wave 1 builder composition (D-409 split-plugin, D-417 §5 lane 2) — the READ half of the mine family, booted WITH its EXTERNAL_MUTATION sibling so the receipt these ops consume exists in the same ledger: vivim.law (phase 0, gate + journal + the consent ceremony), vivim.vault (the proposal ledger that HOLDS the capture receipt), forge.mine.capture (the ONE filesystem seam — forge.mine.capture@1 routed normally, EXTERNAL_MUTATION so the host gates it through law.check@1 before the handler ever reads a byte; the caller performs the two-principal consent ceremony), and forge.mine (READ — forge.mine.verify@1 / forge.mine.diff@1 / forge.mine.list@1, granted exactly two read-only vault ports). The READ ops read the receipt AS STORED: the row capture appended to ns proposal under the content-derived id `mine:<repo>/<rootHash>`, which forge.mine re-derives from the mine id's own pin. Neither plugin class is compromised by sharing this composition: FORGE_CLASS_SPAN is about a plugin's declared contributions, not about which plugins boot together, and the grants stay per-entry. This is a builder composition — no product composition may route forge.* ops (FORGE_IN_PRODUCT).
